CASE_CATEGORIES.DESCRIPTION: The three-level topics agents pick when they solve a chat: Inquiry type, then Category 1 › Category 2 › Category 3, each with its own SLA. Importing a file merges it: a category that already exists is skipped and keeps its SLA.
